measurement.metric_semantics: A span is only an acceptance proxy for sustained useful work when continuous-progress evidence is also present; two sparse timestamps separated by idle time must never count as 14 minutes of work.
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: For a valid acceptance turn, ordered meaningful durable progress evidence must cover the run from substantive start through final progress with no unexplained internal gap greater than 120 seconds. Known waiting/idle intervals are excluded or invalidate the continuous-work claim.
measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_or_handoff_boundary_at - last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known
measurement.target_operating_model: ~840s evidenced sustained useful work + ~60s runtime-safe handoff margin inside each intended 900s interval
measurement.platform_boundary_note: Official Scheduled Tasks documentation describes paid recurring schedules up to once per hour. The quarter-hour fast path is experimental same-task hourly-BYMINUTE mutation, so actual successor observation rather than nominal due time controls measurement validity.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Epoch 14 started substantive work at 23:59:54 but its last durable meaningful progress remained 00:03:23 when the successor was observed at 00:13:49. The >10-minute unexplained gap invalidates continuous-work acceptance and indicates the predecessor turn effectively collapsed long before baton time.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Fast stale-predecessor takeover prevents extra recovery delay but cannot create missing work evidence; the predecessor itself must remain active and checkpoint frequently.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: If each worker treats meaningful <=120-second durable progress refreshes as part of its normal bounded work packet and keeps selecting useful units until successor request, the early-collapse failure will disappear and a valid >=840-second turn can be measured.
next_corrective_experiment.change: During epoch 15, perform useful checkpointable units continuously and persist meaningful progress at <=120-second gaps; after 12 minutes admit only quickly checkpointable units; on successor request finalize measurement and handoff before optional validation/documentation.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: One valid completed turn with >=840s observed useful span, continuous <=120s progress evidence, and immediate successor-triggered handoff; then repeat until 3 valid turns achieve rolling mean >=840s.
